name: bibtex_tools
description: Parse a BibTeX file (nested braces, quoted values, @string macros joined with #, month macros, @preamble, @comment), remove duplicates by DOI and then by normalised title and year, rename keys to authorYEARword with a/b suffixes on collisions, report missing required fields per entry type from the BibTeX documentation, and write the file back as clean, consistently formatted BibTeX.

operations.description: Applied in this order; [] only parses and rewrites

merge.description: On dedupe, copy fields the kept entry lacks from its duplicates

entries.description: Include the parsed entries as JSON

input.bibtex: @article{a, author = {Ada Lovelace}, title = {Notes on the engine}, year = 1843}

catalog.source: BibTeX file format and required fields per entry type from btxdoc (Oren Patashnik, BibTeXing, 1988); key style after the authorYEARword keys of Google Scholar and JabRef
